thread.title: Programmers love Google more than Apple, but dread Microsoft according to 100,000 developers (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT)

author: Matt Weinberger
title: Programmers love Google more than Apple, but dread Microsoft according to 100,000 developers (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT)
text: Programmers love Google more than Apple, but dread Microsoft according to 100,000 developers (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT) By Matt Weinberger Mar 13, 2018, 2:13 pm 13 pts Stack Overflow released its 2018 developer survey results, a massive look into the state of modern programming, with over 101,592 respondents. It finds that Google's Go programming language is a hair more "loved" than Apple's Swift, but that Microsoft's Visual Basic 6 is still the "most dreaded." …
